description: Land Redemption - Order to divest of allotment in Yatameeya, Hapitigam Korale D/S Division, Colombo District and Divulapitiya, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition and divestment matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers related to land matters, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content focuses exclusively on land redemption notices and property descriptions, making it a clear Land Gazette.
